title: SMELL: Sparsity-aware Memory Efficient Federated Fine-tuning for Long-context LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.19349v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated fine-tuning enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to collaboratively adapt to distributed private data. However, long-context fine-tuning on resource-constrained devices faces substantial challenges arising from excessive activation memory, heterogeneous token-importance patterns across clients, and communication overhead. To address these challenges, we propose SMELL, a Sparsity-aware and Memory-Efficient federated fine-tuning framework for Long-context LLMs. SMELL integrates three complementary mechanisms: Local Sparse-Forward Adaptation (LSFA), Consensus-Anchored Sparsity Coordination (CASC), and Communication-Efficient Progressive Update Recovery (CPUR). These mechanisms jointly enable memory-efficient local adaptation, heterogeneity-aware sparsity coordination, and lightweight model-update transmission. translated_title: SMELL：面向长上下文大语言模型的稀疏感知内存高效联邦微调
translated_abstract: 联邦微调使大语言模型（LLM）能够协作地适应分布式的私有数据。然而，在资源受限设备上进行长上下文微调面临着巨大的挑战，这些挑战源于过大的激活内存、客户端之间异构的标记重要性模式以及通信开销。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了SMELL，一个面向长上下文LLM的稀疏感知且内存高效的联邦微调框架。SMELL集成了三种互补机制：局部稀疏前向自适应（LSFA）、共识锚定稀疏协调（CASC）以及通信高效的渐进式更新恢复（CPUR）。这些机制共同实现了内存高效的本地适应、异构性感知的稀疏协调以及轻量级的模型更新传输。在OPT-350M和LLaMA2-7B上的实验表明，SMELL将峰值内存消耗降低了高达88.35%。
tldr: SMELL通过局部稀疏前向自适应、共识锚定稀疏协调和通信高效渐进更新恢复三种机制，解决了资源受限设备上长上下文LLM联邦微调的内存、异构性和通信挑战，峰值内存消耗最多降低88.35%。
en_tdlr: SMELL enables sparsity-aware, memory-efficient federated fine-tuning of long-context LLMs on resource-constrained devices by integrating local sparse-forward adaptation, consensus-anchored sparsity coordination, and communication-efficient update recovery, reducing peak memory consumption by up to 88.35%.
